Vendored subset: cmake/, common/, external/, include/, source/,
builtin-plugin/, CMakeLists.txt, README.md and LICENSE. The examples, tests,
docs, scripts and CI configuration are not part of this checkout.

Local integration details are in app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt: only the
dobby_static target is linked, Plugin.SymbolResolver is disabled, and the
shared libdobby target is excluded from the default build.
